File Upload

A dashed dropzone for attaching a file — drag-and-drop or click to browse. Used in longer forms (quote requests, migration questionnaires) where a document helps the team respond faster.

Code

<!-- icon is an inline Font Awesome Free Solid SVG (cloud-arrow-up) -->
<div class="dropzone">
  <div class="dropzone-left">
    <span class="dropzone-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 576 512" fill="currentColor"><path d="M144 480…"/></svg></span>
    <div class="dropzone-text">
      <div class="title">Drag & drop your file</div>
      <button class="link">Select file from computer <svg class="link-arrow">…</svg></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <span class="dropzone-size">Size up to 100 MB</span>
</div>

<!-- has-file state — swap the icon (circle-check) + text once a file is selected -->
<div class="dropzone has-file">
  <div class="dropzone-left">
    <span class="dropzone-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 512 512" fill="currentColor"><path d="M256 512a256…"/></svg></span>
    <div class="dropzone-text"><div class="title">quote-request.pdf</div></div>
  </div>
  <button class="dz-remove">Remove</button>
</div>
.dropzone {
  border: var(--border-width-1-5) dashed var(--color-border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--rounded-lg);
  padding: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
}
.dropzone-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--rounded-lg);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary) 6%, transparent); border: var(--border-width-1) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary) 10%, transparent);
  color: var(--color-secondary);
}
.dropzone-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }   /* Font Awesome Free Solid, currentColor fill */
.dropzone-text .link { color: var(--color-secondary); font-weight: 700; }
.dropzone-text .link:hover { color: var(--color-primary); }
.dropzone:hover, .dropzone.is-dragover { border-color: var(--color-secondary); background: #F2F9FE; }
.dropzone.error { border-color: var(--color-danger); }
.dropzone.has-file { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--color-border); }
.dropzone.is-disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

Guidelines

✓ Do
Drag & drop your file
  • Always show the accepted size / file type limit up front.
  • Support both drag-and-drop and click-to-browse — never drag-only.
  • Confirm the selected file (name + size) before submit.
✗ Don't
Upload failed
  • Don't fail silently — always show why an upload was rejected.
  • Don't make the dropzone the only way to attach a file.
  • Don't hard-code the tint colours; use the token opacity values.
